// Lists and pipes.
$ true && echo yes; false && echo no
yes
[exit 1]
$ false || echo fallback
fallback
$ ! false && echo negated
negated
$ echo c b a | tr ' ' '\n' | sort
a
b
c
$ nosuch | wc -l
sh: nosuch: not found
0
$ nosuch 2>&1 | wc -l
1
$ (cd /tmp; pwd); pwd
/tmp
/root
$ { echo a; echo b; } | sort -r
b
a
$ sleep 1 &
[1] 8195

// if, while, until, for.
$ if [ -d /tmp ]; then echo dir; elif true; then echo no; else echo no; fi
dir
$ if false; then echo no; else echo else; fi
else
$ for d in /tmp /var /mnt; do echo $d; done
/tmp
/var
/mnt
$ for i in 1 2 3; do if [ $i = 2 ]; then continue; fi; echo $i; done
1
3
$ i=0; while [ $i -lt 3 ]; do i=$((i+1)); echo $i; done
1
2
3
$ i=0; until [ $i -ge 2 ]; do i=$((i+1)); done; echo $i
2
$ for i in 1 2 3; do for j in a b; do [ $j = b ] && break 2; echo $i$j; done; done
1a
$ while true; do :; done
[exit 130]
$ cd /tmp || cd /var/run || cd /mnt || cd /root || cd /; pwd
/tmp

// Syntax errors.
$ | foo
sh: syntax error: unexpected "|"
[exit 2]
$ echo a;; echo b
sh: syntax error: unexpected ";;"
[exit 2]
$ echo (
sh: syntax error: unexpected "("
[exit 2]
$ echo ok &&
> 
sh: syntax error: unexpected end of file
[exit 2]
$ if true; then echo
> 
sh: syntax error: unexpected end of file (expecting "fi")
[exit 2]
$ for x in a b; echo $x; done
sh: syntax error: unexpected "echo" (expecting "do")
[exit 2]
$ then
sh: syntax error: unexpected "then"
[exit 2]
$ fi
sh: syntax error: unexpected "fi"
[exit 2]

// exit ends the session.
$ sh -c 'exit 3'; echo $?
3
$ exit 4
[exit 4]
$ echo unreachable
[exit 4]
